claim: Costco's FY2024 guidance calls for $241.7 billion of revenue.
summary: Costco does not provide forward financial guidance as company policy, so there is no FY2024 company revenue guidance calling for $241.7 billion; actual FY2024 total revenue was ~$254.5 billion.

sub_claims.text: Costco issued formal FY2024 revenue guidance.
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge: Costco has a long-standing policy of not providing forward financial guidance, so there is no formal FY2024 company revenue guidance.

sub_claims.text: Costco's FY2024 guidance amount was $241.7 billion of revenue.
sub_claims.note: No such company guidance exists; actual FY2024 total revenue was materially higher at ~$254.5 billion, so $241.7 billion was not Costco's guidance.
